warning.title: Please read this first
warning.allergy_match: Your record shows an allergy to {{allergy}}. {{item}} can cause a serious reaction for you. Do not take or eat it unless your doctor has checked your allergy.
warning.nsaid_pregnancy: Your record shows you are about {{weeks}} weeks pregnant. Painkillers like {{item}} are usually avoided after 20 weeks because they can harm the baby. Do not take it unless your doctor says so. Ask your doctor what is safe for your pain.
warning.ace_arb_pregnancy: Your record shows you are pregnant. BP medicines like {{item}} are not used in pregnancy because they can harm the baby. Do not start it, and do not change your BP medicine without your doctor.
warning.preg_htn_warning_sign: Your record shows you are about {{weeks}} weeks pregnant with high BP. Headache, blurred vision, swelling, upper stomach pain or less baby movement can be warning signs of pre-eclampsia. Go to the hospital now or call 108.
warning.preg_danger_sign: Your record shows you are about {{weeks}} weeks pregnant. Blurred vision, upper stomach pain or less baby movement are danger signs. Go to the hospital now or call 108.
warning.high_salt_bp: Your record shows high BP. Pickles, papad, namkeen and other salty foods raise BP. Avoid them or eat very little, and follow your doctor's diet advice.
warning.dose_change: Do not stop, skip or change your {{item}} on your own. Ask your doctor before changing any medicine.
warning.dose_change_any: Do not stop, skip or change your medicines on your own. Ask your doctor before changing any medicine.
